name: enable-save-menu
title: Put Save back in the in-game menu
why: These games hide the Save command rather than disabling saving. System.json's menuCommands
array is [item, skill, equip, status, formation, save], and every one of Fear & Hunger,
Termina and Look Outside ships with the last entry set to false -- so Window_MenuCommand
never adds the command, and you can only save where the game gives you a save point.
Neither Fear & Hunger nor Termina ever issues a 'Change Save Access: disable', so saving is
already enabled at runtime; it is only the menu entry that is missing. Flipping this one
boolean in YOUR OWN copy of System.json puts it back.
Look Outside is different -- it actively manages save rights through a manageSaveRights common
event with 122 access changes -- so this patch is not offered for it.
